limit: Older active risks and time-specific facts remain beside newer evidence; resolve requires an actual conflict relationship
mitigation: Reviewed presentations select and cite the latest findings; full-ledger exports retain history

limit: Paid-provider CLI research needs locally configured credentials; native host fixture tests do not replace real host tasks
mitigation: Install the local build in the target host and exercise it on a real task before claiming host readiness

limit: Model-backed research runs only through explicit local CLI or host operations; no browser app or hosted execution service is bundled
mitigation: Use headless preparation without provider access, then authorize the intended local provider or host run

limit: Website code and unused site assets are excluded; the product retains CLI/MCP, generated reports and documentation branding
mitigation: Package absence gates reject public directories and retired web launchers while exercising installed CLI/MCP/report workflows

limit: Semantic-v2 found no general answer-quality or efficiency improvement; verification catches specified failures, not source truth
mitigation: Use explicit verifiers and adversarial rejected-claims checks; never claim universal accuracy or cost gains

limit: Local verification does not perform remote CI, deployment, publication, or repository archival without authorization
mitigation: Require green CI and explicit maintainer release authorization before tagging or publishing
